## Introduction

The Human Metabolome Database (HMDB) [@wishart2007] [@wishart2022] is searched for the exact masses of the features extracted in "Conjugate Screening" to potentially identify unknown features. For this, a list of all known and predicted human metabolites was obtained from HMDB (248,373 entries) and is searched with 5 ppm tolerance (± 2.5 ppm).

### Important Note

Note that the list of metabolites is not re-distributed with this file and if this file should be re-rendered locally, a list of metabolites must first be obtained from HMDB and placed in the `hmdb_files` folder. The list can be obtained from https://www.hmdb.ca/metabolites via the Export button, without filters selected.

## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read Files

### Read the metabolites list

This file must be obtained from HMDB and placed in the `hmdb_files` folder. See the [Important Note] section.

```{r}
hmdb_file_folder <- "hmdb_files/"
hmdb_file_loc <- paste0(hmdb_file_folder, list.files(hmdb_file_folder))

hmdb_metabolites <- read_csv(hmdb_file_loc)
```

### Read the feature tables

```{r}
ft_files_folder <- "files/"
ft_files_names <- list.files(ft_files_folder)
ft_files_loc <- paste0(ft_files_folder, ft_files_names)

ft_files_wide <- ft_files_loc |>
  map(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = "cdd")

names(ft_files_wide) <- ft_files_names

ft_long <- ft_files_wide |>
  map(select, 1:3) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "file_name") |>
  mutate(file_name = str_remove_all(file_name, "\\.csv$")) |>
  mutate(polarity = str_extract(file_name, "^[a-z]{3}")) |>
  mutate(compound = str_remove_all(str_extract(file_name, "\\_[a-z]{1,}\\_"), "_")) |>
  mutate(conjugate = str_extract(file_name, "[a-z]{1,}$")) |>
  mutate(exact_mass = as.numeric(str_extract(Feature, "^[0-9]{1,}\\.[0-9]{1,}")))
```


## Search HMDB

```{r}
search_ms1 <- function(mass, db, tol) {
  tol_ppm = mass * tol / 1000000
  
  filtered <- db |>
    mutate(near = near(MONO_MASS, mass, tol = tol_ppm)) |>
    filter(near == TRUE) 
  
  tibble(Name = filtered |> 
           pull(NAME) |>
           paste(collapse = " | "),
         HMDB = filtered |> 
           pull(HMDB_ID) |>
           paste(collapse = " | "),
         Measured_Mass = round(mass, digits = 4), 
         Nominal = filtered |> 
           pull(MONO_MASS) |>
           round(digits = 4) |>
           paste(collapse = " | "),
         Deviation = filtered |> 
           mutate(dev = abs(round((mass - MONO_MASS) / MONO_MASS * 1000000, digits = 1)))|> 
           pull(dev) |>
           paste(collapse = " | "))
}

search_ms1(327.0951, hmdb_metabolites, tol = 2.5)

ft_results <- ft_long |>
  mutate(match = map(exact_mass, search_ms1, hmdb_metabolites, 2.5)) |>
  unnest(match)
```

## Tidy and write results do disk

```{r}
ft_results_tidy <- ft_results |>
  mutate(compound = str_to_title(compound)) |>
  transmute(
    `Treatment Compound` = compound,
    `m/z` = `m/z`,
    RT = RT,
    Polarity = polarity,
    Name = Name,
    HMDB = HMDB,
    `Probable Conjugate` = conjugate,
    `Measured Mass / Da` = exact_mass,
    `Theoretical Mass / Da` = Nominal,
    `Absolute Deviation / ppm` = Deviation
  ) |>
  mutate(`Treatment Compound` = case_when(`Treatment Compound` == "Nitrophenol" ~ "4-Nitrophenol",
                                          .default = `Treatment Compound`)) |>
  mutate(Polarity = str_replace_all(Polarity, "neg", "Negative"),
         Polarity = str_replace_all(Polarity, "pos", "Positive")) |>
  mutate(`Probable Conjugate` = case_when(`Probable Conjugate` == "glcac" ~ "Glucuronic acid",
                                          `Probable Conjugate` == "gsh" ~ "Glutathione",
                                          `Probable Conjugate` == "sulfate" ~ "Sulfate"))

knitr::kable(ft_results_tidy)

write_csv(ft_results_tidy, "output/hmdb_matching.csv")
```
